name: Pettenderly
tagline: Create downloadable AI pet portraits from photos of your cat or dog.
short: Pettenderly turns photos of your cat or dog into downloadable AI pet portraits in watercolor, royal, studio and window-seat styles.
description: Pettenderly is an AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a style, and create a digital portrait to download. Styles include watercolor, royal portraits, studio scenes and sunny window-seat settings. The service uses paid credits, with no credit charged for failed generations. Generated faces, markings and details can vary.
notes: Launched in October 2026. Pricing starts at $4.99 for 12 credits, with subscriptions from $9.90/month. No free generation plan. Official X: https://x.com/soulpaw_art
